input: Sort and label all tax documents by category

gold.taskTitle: Sort and Label Tax Documents by Category
gold.taskDescription: Organize all tax-related documents into clearly labeled categories for easy retrieval and use.

questions.title: Which tax year(s) do these documents cover?
questions.description: Identify the specific tax year or range of years the documents belong to.

questions.title: Are the documents physical, digital, or both?
questions.description: Determine the format of the documents to plan the sorting method appropriately.

questions.title: What categories do you want to sort them into?
questions.description: Establish the specific categories such as income, deductions, investments, receipts, etc.

questions.title: How many documents are you working with roughly?
questions.description: Gauge the volume of documents to estimate the time and effort required.

questions.title: Do you have a filing system already partially set up?
questions.description: Find out if there is an existing structure to build on or if this starts from scratch.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing this task?
questions.description: Understand any time pressure, such as an upcoming tax filing date or accountant meeting.

questions.title: Who will be using these documents after sorting?
questions.description: Clarify whether the documents are for personal use, a tax professional, or a business accountant, to tailor labeling conventions.
